resources.string: Looking for PCs running KB STUDIO SCREEN…
No PC found. Make sure kbss-engine is running on the PC and both are on the same Wi-Fi. You can also scan the QR code or type the IP.
A 6-digit PIN appeared on the PC screen. Type it here, then approve this device on the PC.
Waiting for this device to be approved on the PC…
Point at the QR code shown by kbss-engine on the PC
This version does not stream audio.
Could not reach the PC. Is kbss-engine running? Are both on the same network? Guest networks may isolate devices.
The PC already has 3 devices connected.
The PIN expired. Request a new one.
Too many attempts. Wait 2 minutes and request a new PIN.
The device was not approved on the PC.
Warning! The PC identity does not match. There may be an attacker on the network. Not connected.
The PC no longer recognizes this device. Pair again.
Incompatible versions between app and PC. Update both.
That QR code is not from KB STUDIO SCREEN or has expired.
